Title: Implement Telemetry Client Worker in Agent
Description: Add background goroutine in cmd/terminator-agent/main.go with configurable -server-url flag to push heartbeats to terminator-server.
Acceptance Criteria: Agent sends POST /api/fleet/heartbeat every 10 seconds with CPU/memory stats and query counters.

Title: Implement Local Buffer & Batch Flush in AuditLogger
Description: Add FlushToRemote method in pkg/audit/logger.go to batch and push new audit events to the central server.
Acceptance Criteria: New events are queued in a thread-safe buffer and flushed in batches. Exponential backoff on failure.

Title: Implement /api/events/ingest Endpoint on Server
Description: Add HTTP handler in cmd/terminator-server/main.go to accept JSON batch payloads of ThreatEvent arrays from agents.
Acceptance Criteria: Server ingests events into central audit memory and JSONL log. Returns 200 OK on success.

Title: Implement /api/fleet/heartbeat Endpoint on Server
Description: Add HTTP handler in cmd/terminator-server/main.go to receive agent heartbeat status and dynamically update fleet device state.
Acceptance Criteria: Fleet registry updates last_seen, cpu_usage, and status fields dynamically on each heartbeat.

Title: Broadcast Ingested Agent Events to WebSocket Clients
Description: Connect the server event ingestion pipeline to broadcastWS so connected dashboard clients receive instant alerts.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard live threat feed auto-populates within 100ms of agent event ingestion.

Title: Add fsnotify Dependency and Watcher Loop to FSGuard
Description: Add github.com/fsnotify/fsnotify to go.mod and implement recursive directory watcher in pkg/monitor/fs_guard.go watching ~/Downloads, ~/Documents, ~/Desktop.
Acceptance Criteria: Watcher starts on agent boot, receives live file create/rename/modify events, CPU overhead remains under 0.5%.

Title: Implement Bulk Entropy Calculator in FSGuard
Description: Calculate Shannon entropy of modified files larger than 64KB in pkg/monitor/fs_guard.go.
Acceptance Criteria: Triggers Severity 9 AUTO_BLOCK ThreatEvent when entropy >= 7.8 across bulk write operations.

Title: Implement Ransomware Extension Tripwire in FSGuard
Description: Detect file renames to known ransomware extensions (.locky, .wanacry, .crypt, etc.) using the existing KnownRansomwareExtensions map.
Acceptance Criteria: Triggers Severity 10 AUTO_BLOCK ThreatEvent immediately on detection of any known ransomware extension rename.

Title: Implement GetActiveConnections in PlatformManager Interface
Description: Add GetActiveConnections() method to platform.PlatformManager interface returning a list of active TCP/UDP socket endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria: Returns slice of active remote IP+port pairs. Implemented for Darwin (via netstat) and Windows (via netstat -n).

Title: Implement Darwin GetActiveConnections via netstat
Description: Implement GetActiveConnections for darwinPlatform in pkg/platform/platform_darwin.go using exec netstat -an output parsing.
Acceptance Criteria: Returns active TCP connection remote endpoints as (IP, port) pairs.

Title: Implement Windows GetActiveConnections via netstat
Description: Implement GetActiveConnections for windowsPlatform in pkg/platform/platform_windows.go using exec netstat -n output parsing.
Acceptance Criteria: Returns active TCP connection remote endpoints as (IP, port) pairs.

Title: Wire Active Socket List to NetworkMonitor Inspection Loop
Description: Connect platform GetActiveConnections output to nm.InspectConnection in pkg/monitor/net_monitor.go on a 1-second polling interval.
Acceptance Criteria: Alerts broadcasted when suspicious egress connections to known malicious CIDRs or port scan patterns are identified.

Title: Implement LoadRulesFromJSON in ThreatAnalyzer
Description: Add LoadRulesFromJSON(data []byte) method to pkg/engine/analyzer.go that parses a JSON rule bundle and atomically replaces Radix Tree and Bloom Filter contents.
Acceptance Criteria: Rules update in memory atomically under 1ms without dropping live traffic evaluation.

Title: Implement Remote Rule Puller in Agent
Description: Add hourly background ticker in cmd/terminator-agent/main.go to fetch rule bundles from server /api/rules/sync and call analyzer.LoadRulesFromJSON.
Acceptance Criteria: Agent pulls and hot-reloads updated threat signatures hourly without daemon restart.

Title: Implement /api/rules/sync Endpoint on Server
Description: Add HTTP handler in cmd/terminator-server/main.go serving versioned JSON threat rule bundles to requesting agents.
Acceptance Criteria: Returns current rule bundle as JSON with version header. Agents can conditionally pull only if version changed.

Title: Add terminator-cli sync-rules Command
Description: Add sync-rules subcommand to cmd/terminator-cli/main.go that triggers immediate rule refresh via IPC or direct server fetch.
Acceptance Criteria: CLI command forces immediate rule pull and prints confirmation with rule count and version.

Title: Implement Standalone IPC Prompt Client Binary
Description: Create cmd/terminator-prompt/main.go that connects to the agent Unix socket, listens for MsgTypePromptUser events, and handles response dispatch.
Acceptance Criteria: Client connects to IPC socket, receives prompt events, and sends back MsgTypeUserDecision within the 4-second timeout window.

Title: Implement Native macOS Dialog for User Prompt
Description: Use osascript (AppleScript) in terminator-prompt to display a native dialog with Allow Once, Always Block, Trust Source buttons.
Acceptance Criteria: Dialog appears within 500ms of prompt event on macOS. User button selection is captured and returned over IPC.

Title: Implement Native Windows Dialog for User Prompt
Description: Use Windows MessageBox via exec or CGO in terminator-prompt to display a blocking dialog with Allow Once, Always Block, Trust Source options.
Acceptance Criteria: Dialog appears within 500ms of prompt event on Windows. User button selection is captured and returned over IPC.

Title: Add DoH HTTP Handler to DNSProxy
Description: Implement RFC 8484 DNS-over-HTTPS handler at /dns-query in pkg/interceptor/dns_proxy.go supporting GET and POST with application/dns-message content type.
Acceptance Criteria: Handles DoH GET and POST requests, evaluates domain through ThreatAnalyzer, returns NXDOMAIN wire-format response for blocked domains.

Title: Create pkg/ipc/ipc_test.go
Description: Write unit tests for IPC server and client covering status retrieval, audit event query, and prompt user decision round-trip.
Acceptance Criteria: All IPC test cases pass under go test -v -race. Round-trip prompt decision completes under 5ms.

Title: Create pkg/audit/logger_test.go
Description: Write unit tests for AuditLogger covering subscriber broadcast, ring buffer truncation at max capacity, and JSONL file persistence.
Acceptance Criteria: Validates thread-safety under concurrent writes. Ring buffer stays within maxMemory bounds.

Title: Create pkg/monitor/monitor_test.go
Description: Write unit tests for FSGuard and NetworkMonitor covering ransomware extension detection, entropy heuristic, and port scan detection.
Acceptance Criteria: Simulated rapid file renames and port sweeps trigger correct ThreatEvent severity and action.

Title: Create pkg/interceptor/dns_proxy_test.go
Description: Write unit tests for DNSProxy simulating UDP DNS queries for whitelisted, blocked, and queued domains.
Acceptance Criteria: Whitelisted domains forward upstream. Malicious domains return NXDOMAIN or 0.0.0.0 sinkhole response.
